jobs.title: Senior People Intelligence, Automation & AI Specialist
jobs.description: Are you passionate about transforming HR through automation, digital solutions, and AI? We are looking for a Senior People Intelligence, Automation & AI Specialist to lead our HR automation and AI agenda. In this role, you will drive the automation roadmap, transform complex global HR processes into scalable and controlled digital solutions, and act as the key link between HR, HRIT, IT, data, security, and technology partners. Leveraging technologies such as Microsoft Power Platform, Copilot, AI agents, and Microsoft Fabric, you will deliver measurable improvements in efficiency, control, user experience, and organizational capability. This position has a global impact on the digital maturity, scalability, and governance of HR services. You will help shape how HR processes are designed, how technology and AI are responsibly applied, and how reporting and operational solutions are governed across functions and countries. By replacing manual and fragmented activities with automated workflows and AI-driven capabilities, you will enable faster processes, stronger controls, reduced operational risk, and sustainable business value. If you are excited by the opportunity to influence the future of HR technology, drive meaningful transformation, and deliver measurable business impact at a global scale, we would love to hear from you. MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES Lead the HR automation and AI roadmap, identifying opportunities to streamline and optimize people processes through digital solutions. Design, build, and implement automation solutions using Microsoft Power Platform, AI tools, and other approved technologies. Develop and maintain HR reporting, dashboards, and people intelligence solutions that support data-driven decision-making. Partner with HR, HRIT, IT, Data & Analytics, Security, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable digital solutions. Drive the responsible adoption of AI technologies, including Copilot and AI agents, within the HR function.
